# Condition Group

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ConditionGroup`](gmeow-ConditionGroup.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ConditionGroup>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)

A composite condition — all-of, any-of, or none-of its members (arbitrary and/or/not trees by nesting groups). Requires an operator and at least two members (SHACL). A group is itself a [`Condition`](gmeow-Condition.md): it carries its own prose summary and can be evaluated, formalized, and reused like any other.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Condition`](gmeow-Condition.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ConditionGroup`](gmeow-ConditionGroup.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Condition`](gmeow-Condition.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
